title: salvia carnosa subsp. typica
intro: Salvia carnosa subsp. typica, commonly known as Rose Sage, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rose Sage are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils such as camphor and borneol, that exhibit sedative, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's bioactive compounds work together to promote relaxation, relieve pain, and support overall well-being.
